summary: The `ExpenseBatch` class facilitates the creation, update, and management of expense batches, including operations such as adding, updating, and deleting expense batch records.
purpose: To manage financial records related to departmental expenses, providing batch processing capabilities within the HSPnet framework.

properties.name: ID
properties.description: Unique identifier for the expense batch.

properties.name: DepartmentID
properties.description: Identifier for the department managing the expenses.

properties.name: BatchDate
properties.description: Date of the expense batch record.

properties.name: StatusCode
properties.description: Current status code of the batch.
